headline: TENNESSEE 🛑 HALTS 💉 EXECUTIONS after Christa Pike SURVIVES 🧟 TWO Lethal 🍆 INJECTION Attempts
text:
TENNESSEE 🏠 just SLAMMED 🛑 the brakes 🚗 on ALL executions ⚰️ for the rest of the YEAR 📅 after death row inmate CHRISTA 🧍‍♀️ PIKE straight up SURVIVED 🫀 not one but TWO back to back lethal 💉 injection doses of pentobarbital 🧪 and they had to RUSH 🏥 her to the HOSPITAL 🏥 still BREATHING 😮‍💨!! Governor Bill Lee 🧔 looked straight up DISAPPOINTED 😣 while calling the whole botched mess one of the state's most SERIOUS 🪖 responsibilities and immediately ordered an independent REVIEW 🔎 because the people of Tennessee deserve ANSWERS 📢!! Pike who was only EIGHTEEN 🔞 when she and boyfriend Tadaryl beat tortured and KILLED 🔪 Colleen Slemmer back in NINETY SIX 📆 would have been the first woman executed in the state in over TWO HUNDRED years ⏳ but instead she got two full DOSES 💊 of the stuff and still needed life saving MEASURES 🩹 according to her lawyers who are screaming about cruel and unusual PUNISHMENT ⚖️!! "It was a MESS 😵" said Slemmer's mom May Martinez who showed up to WATCH 👀 the whole thing go sideways while prison officials are over here defending their protocol like they didn't just EDGE 🫦 this execution for HOURS 🕒 before tapping out and hauling her off the gurney still ALIVE 🧬!!

This whole NIGHTMARE 😱 unfolded after a flurry of last minute legal CHALLENGES ⚔️ from Pike's team got shot down by the US Supreme Court at the literal LAST 🕛 hour only for the Tennessee Department of Correction to fumble the bag twice with the same lethal chemical that had been working FINE 🧪 every other time according to their own statement!! They claim they followed every single STEP 🦶 of the approved protocol and didn't go beyond what was allowed yet here we are with a fifty year old woman back from the brink after two full attempts that left everyone involved looking DOWN BAD 🫠!! Governor Lee promised the investigation will be THOROUGH 🕵️ and take TIME ⏳ because there are a LOT of questions that the people of the state need answered before anyone else gets strapped to that table and Governor Daddy 🧔 is not playing around with this pause that now overlaps the planned December execution of Gary Sutton too!! Her lawyers are filing papers left and right claiming unnecessary AGONY 🩸 and violation of rights while the attorney general's office nodded along saying yeah we gotta figure out what the hell HAPPENED 🧐!!

Republican Senator Marsha Blackburn who is running for governor herself called the whole disaster TRAGIC 😢 and suggested the simple answer is to just BRING BACK ⚡ the electric chair because this lethal injection thing clearly isn't cutting it anymore while her Democrat opponent Jerri Green clapped back hard saying she would put a full MORATORIUM 🚫 on all future executions if she wins!! This marks the SECOND ⏳ time in twenty twenty six that Tennessee officials have tried and completely FAILED ❌ to execute a prisoner after Tony Carruthers got a one year REPRIEVE 🛡️ back in May when they couldn't even find a VEIN 🩸 to stick the needle in!! Pike had been sitting on death row since her conviction for the brutal murder of nineteen year old Colleen and now the entire process is under a microscope with witnesses describing the botched attempt as an absolute CIRCUS 🎪 that left the mother of the victim saying it was just one big chaotic MESS 🌀!! The prison folks insist the chemical has been consistently effective and their protocol is sound but after two doses and a hospital trip the state is hitting the pause button HARD 🛑 on the whole thing until they can get their execution game together!!

Bill Lee stood in front of reporters on Thursday looking like a man who just got blue balled by the entire justice system while stressing how seriously the state takes this responsibility and swearing the review will leave no stone UNTURNED 🪨!! Pike's medical condition remains unclear after they wheeled her out still breathing following the second failed dose which according to court filings triggered immediate life saving intervention that her legal team is now using to argue the whole thing crossed into cruel territory real QUICK 🏃‍♀️!! Tennessee hasn't executed a woman in over two centuries so this was supposed to be historic but instead it turned into one of the most embarrassing state screw ups in recent memory with everyone from the attorney general to random bystanders agreeing something went HORRIBLY 🩸 wrong during those two injection attempts!! The Department of Correction released a statement doubling down that they stuck exactly to the book and the pentobarbital should have done the job yet here we are with Christa Pike alive in a hospital bed while the governor slams a temporary BAN 🚫 on all further lethal procedures for the rest of the calendar YEAR 📅!!

From the Supreme Court intervention at the eleventh hour to the mother of the victim traveling all the way to witness what became a total flop the layers of this story keep unfolding like a late night true crime RABBITHOLE 🕳️ that has lawmakers on both sides throwing out wild suggestions from electric chairs ⚡ to complete halts on capital punishment!! Marsha Blackburn is out here saying bring back the old methods while Jerri Green vows a full stop if elected showing just how divided the reaction has been to Pike surviving not one but two full strength doses meant to end her life!! The independent review ordered by Governor Lee will apparently take significant time and tackle every question swirling around how this execution got so thoroughly COOKED 🍳 despite following established protocol and now the state finds itself in the awkward position of explaining why their most serious responsibility turned into a public spectacle of survival and HOSPITAL 🚑 runs!! This isn't the first recent failure either since Tony Carruthers dodged the needle earlier this year when veins became the ultimate villain leaving Tennessee's death row machinery looking straight up BROKEN 🛠️ and in desperate need of this thorough examination before anyone else climbs onto that gurney!!
